title: The Tower of Babel and Shem's Line

questions.question: What did the people at Babel try to build?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:4: They planned to build a city and a tower with its top in the heavens.

questions.question: What did God do to stop the building project?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:7: God confused their language so they could not understand each other.

questions.question: What does "Babel" mean?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:9: The name Babel sounds like the Hebrew word for "confused."

questions.question: Who was Abram's father?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:26: "Terah fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran."

questions.question: Where did Terah and his family originally come from?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:31: Terah took his family from Ur of the Chaldeans.

questions.question: What materials did the people use to build at Babel?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:3: They used brick for stone and bitumen for mortar.

questions.question: Why did the people want to build the tower?
options: To make a name for themselves
questions.correctAnswer: To make a name for themselves
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:4: "let us make a name for ourselves, lest we be dispersed."

questions.question: Where did Terah settle instead of reaching Canaan?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:31: They intended to go to Canaan but settled in Haran.

questions.question: Who was Sarai's husband?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:29: "Abram and Nahor took wives. The name of Abram's wife was Sarai."

questions.question: What does Genesis 11:30 say about Sarai?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:30: "Now Sarai was barren; she had no child."

questions.question: How old was Terah when he died?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:32: "The days of Terah were 205 years, and Terah died in Haran."

questions.question: At what age did Shem father Arpachshad?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:10: Shem was 100 years old when he fathered Arpachshad.

questions.question: How long did Eber live?
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:16-17: Eber lived 464 years in total.

questions.question: What was the land of Shinar known for in Genesis 11?
options: The location of the tower of Babel
questions.correctAnswer: The location of the tower of Babel
questions.explanation: Genesis 11:2: The people settled in Shinar and built the tower there.

key_verse_text: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the Lord confused the language of all the earth.
